prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for sign_in and reorder changes, as only one test has been completed so far.
Evidence is still thin for finish and new_flow changes, as only one test has been completed so far.
No clear effect was seen for adoption and redesign changes across 2 tests, as neither showed a significant win.
Predictions were consistently too high compared to noise-corrected results across all tests.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: -0.1% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- finish, new_flow: -1.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: +0.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, layout] Story Card Split Layout Redesign: Redesign the story screen into a split layout showcasing the companion visual preview on one side and key feature highlights on the other. (why: The choose_path drop-off is 23.8% with a long mean time of 514s, indicating initial user hesitation.)
1: [adoption, wait_info] Photo Processing Status Hint: Display status hint text and dynamic progress indicators on the photo upload screen during pet generation. (why: Support noted 3 emails about custom pet creation failing or output looking incorrect during photo processing.)
2: [home, notification] Desktop Ready Alert Sound: Trigger a notification chime sound on the waiting screen once desktop initialization completes. (why: Home step median time is 201s (mean 2336s), and users reported pets failing to appear when app finishes loading quietly.)
3: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Shortcut Controls Overview Screen: Add a new sub-flow screen 'new_controls_overview' before home intro introducing essential keyboard shortcuts and desktop visibility controls. (why: 3 support emails reported confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after completing setup.)
4: [finish, new_screen] Onboarding Celebration Reward Screen: Insert a new celebratory screen 'new_completion_reward' at the end of onboarding to confirm setup is complete. (why: Finish step conversion is 64.8% with high drop-off; a clear completion signal reassures users.)
5: [sign_in, copy] Sign-In Value Proposition Copy Update: Update sign-in headline and body copy to emphasize cross-device cloud sync and pet data security. (why: Sign-in conversion is 72.9% and multiple users were confused about lost pets when switching devices.)
